variants.text: Young female with an oval face, thin soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, straight nose, and brown hair.
Young adult female with an oval face, thin soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with double-lid creases, and a straight nose, styled with brown hair obscuring part of the forehead.

Young adult female with an oval face shape. Features include thin, soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with upward canthal tilt and double upper-lid creases, a straight nose with a rounded tip, and a medium-width mouth with balanced lip fullness. Brown hair partially obscures the forehead and left eye region.

This is a young woman with an oval-shaped face, thin arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes that have visible creases on the lids. She has a straight nose and well-defined lips, and her brown hair is styled so that it falls over her forehead and part of her left eye.
